name: National ICT Centre
developer: SKN Department of Technology / Government of St. Kitts and Nevis
notes: Confirmed government-operated National ICT Centre/data center at #3 C.A. Paul Southwell Industrial Site, Bay Road, Basseterre. DataCenterMap lists it as operational since 2007; Department of Technology identifies the National ICT Centre at the C.A. Paul Industrial Site as the venue for 2024 digital-services network workshops; Carib Journal describes it as the national data center housing government servers.

name: State-of-the-art national data center plan
developer: Government of St. Kitts and Nevis
notes: Official SKNIS report says the Prime Minister announced plans to build a state-of-the-art data center in St. Kitts and Nevis as part of the digital economy agenda. No specific site, capacity, schedule, or later completion evidence was found; grouped under the capital parish because the announcement and known national ICT/data-center activity are Basseterre-linked, but the source does not disclose a parcel.

name: Digicel St. Kitts & Nevis colocation facility
notes: Digicel Business's St. Kitts & Nevis product page offers colocation in an audited data-centre facility with space for IT hardware, physical security, backup power/redundancy, and cooling. Public page does not disclose a street address or parish; listed under Saint George Basseterre because public data-center market listings and telecom/cable landing activity center on Basseterre.
